=You are a meeting scheduling assistant for someone based in India (IST, Asia/Kolkata). You schedule calls with leads worldwide. parameters.query:
SELECT meet_link, lead_email, event_id, start_time
FROM propmeetings
WHERE status = 'scheduled'
  AND start_time < now() - interval '10 minutes';

UPDATE propmeetings
SET status = 'transcript_ready',
    fireflies_meeting_id = '{{ $json.meeting_id }}',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE meet_link = '{{ $json.meet_link }}';

INSERT INTO propmeetings (meet_link, lead_email, event_id, start_time, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.meet_link }}',
  '{{ $json.lead_email }}',
  '',
  '{{ $json.start_time }}',
  'scheduled'
)
ON CONFLICT (meet_link) DO NOTHING;
